channel.title: Joshua Small
channel.description: Staff software engineer at Aiwyn. I built its payments platform from zero to $2.38B in payment volume.

item.title: My first benchmark scored 100%, which meant it was broken
item.description: Two eval runs for $0.55 turned up a data bug, a saturated benchmark, 43% accuracy on winnability, and underconfident calibration.

item.title: Haiku and Opus agreed on the category and disagreed on whether to fight
item.description: On a mislabeled "fraud" chargeback, both models found the real category. Only Opus asked for the evidence that would decide the case.

item.title: One request shape doesn't fit every Claude model
item.description: Haiku 4.5 rejects adaptive thinking and the effort parameter, so model-agnostic code needs per-model request shaping.

item.title: The Anthropic SDK can inherit a base URL from your environment
item.description: Run inside a Claude Code session, the SDK picks up the session's gateway URL without any error. Pin base_url explicitly.

item.title: A contractor just wanted to send an invoice
item.description: Why I built Invoicebolt, a free invoice generator with no sign-up, no subscription, and no watermark.
